description: Repairs r-sql-2-3/pivot-headings: a duplicate in the IN list and a Null in PN. Asks the heading order of a fixed list without a duplicate, IN ('c', 'b', 'a', 'zz') and IN ('a', 'zz', 'c'), and the headings of PIVOT CStr(PN), IIf(ID Mod 2 = 0, PN, CStr(PN)) and PN over only the rows where PN is not Null; the schema is published before any move and the rows are read. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
